capabilities: Render mahjong hands from MPSZ notation in mahjong code blocks
Show dark and light theme tile images
Mark called tiles and kans with quote rotation notation
Render red fives using the 0 notation
disambiguation: Not a mahjong game or score calculator; it only renders notation strings as tiles (han/fu computation is a future plan).
extras: Installation section is marked 'To be completed'; future plans include different tile themes, han/fu scoring, and tile variants for Chinese and Singaporean rules.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show mahjong hands from tile notation, so players must describe hands in plain text.
summary: Code-block renderer that displays riichi mahjong hands as tile images from MPSZ notation strings like 123m456p789s11z.
